h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gudivada

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gudivada

items.pText: Gudivada is a market town in the Krishna delta, ringed by paddy fields, canals and fish ponds. Schools, colleges and new residential layouts are the main buyers of play equipment here, and many of them collect two or three quotes before they decide. FunPlay Systems supplies Gudivada from our factory in Vasai, about 920 km away, and sends every order to Andhra Pradesh by road.

Two quotes for the same slide can look identical on paper and turn out very different on the ground. A single price line rarely shows what the frame is made of, whether installation is included or which parts the warranty covers. We set these out item by item, so you can compare like with like. In a hot, humid delta town with a heavy monsoon, the material of each piece matters far more than the catalogue photo.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Four checks before you compare quotes

items: Is the frame galvanised steel, or painted mild steel that will rust once the paint chips?
Are the slides and panels roto-moulded plastic, or painted sheet metal?
Does the price cover delivery, installation and foundation work, or only the equipment?
Which parts does the warranty cover, and for how long?

c: Our quote answers each of these. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years against manufacturing defects, and springs and bearings carry 1 year. For nearby towns, see

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 920 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can your quote include installation and flooring?
items.a: Yes. Tell us what you want included, such as installation, foundation work or rubber flooring, and we will list each item separately so you can compare our quote with others.

items.q: Why does galvanised steel matter in the Krishna delta?
items.a: The air here stays humid for most of the year. Galvanised steel has a zinc coating that protects it from rust, while painted mild steel starts rusting wherever the paint gets scratched.

items.q: Can we get a layout drawing along with the quote?
items.a: Yes. Share the site size, a few photos and the age group of the children. We will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked together with an itemised quote.
